contexts.text: They infuse their poison so clandestinely...
They who act beneath the occiput operate more clandestinely than others.
They clandestinely explore minds with a purpose of doing harm, and clandestinely lay an ambush in order to destroy.
Such men become Genii... who have done evil, but clandestinely, and through others.
This they pervert in a moment, so clandestinely...
Genii inflow into the affections... so clandestinely that it cannot be at all perceived.
Those (dwell in vaults) whose delight it has been to lay an ambush clandestinely.
They who have not acted clandestinely...
The Spirits whose delight it has been to act clandestinely...
They would clandestinely attempt similar things...
Genii... turn good affections into evil ones... so clandestinely that the other knows nothing about it...
